title: Reconciliation classification correctness and authoritative in-flight manifest resolution

sha_binding.verified_source_note: This lane's implementation commit and the last non-proof commit on the branch. It carries every source control this bundle describes. It is the anchor only because a file cannot contain its own SHA; post-merge rebinding sets the merge SHA.

scope.diff_stat_note: Measured with git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD -- scripts/ops/ at the anchor SHA. The whole-diff total is deliberately not quoted because it would count this proof bundle.

runtime_proof.reason: Governance/reconciliation tooling only. No runtime, database, migration, deployment, ingestion or delivery path is touched. Production containment in force throughout: no SGO call, no production mutation, no production DDL, no member delivery, no unpark, no secret access.

mutation_testing.method: Each of the 7 regression fixtures is paired with a mutation of its own input that must flip the classification. A fixture that only ever runs green is not accepted as a control.

controls.asserts: ORCH-OPEN-PR-MANIFEST-URL pass, resolved from PR head
controls.mutation: head manifest removed, leaving only the stale working-tree copy
controls.flips_to: fail, dispatch_blocking, resolved from working tree / main

controls.asserts: ORCH-INFRA, infra_error, exit 3, no historical decay
controls.mutation: same issue with Entity not found
controls.flips_to: historical decay, warning, exit 0; and a 401 stays blocking

mutation_testing.classifier_table: classifyLinearLookupError is asserted over deleted, transient (timeout, ETIMEDOUT, 429, 503, ENOTFOUND), auth (401, Authentication required), and unknown. ENOTFOUND is specifically asserted transient, because its text contains 'not found'.

allowlist_check.requirement: Do not implement a hard-coded issue allowlist.
allowlist_check.result: 3 matches, all generic: two ID-shape regexes (/\b((?:UTV2|UNI)-\d+)\b/i, /^(UTV2|UNI)-\d+$/) and one CLI usage string. No issue identifier appears in any branch condition.

issue_evidence_correction.field: UTV2-1652 row of the issue's ORCH-OPEN-PR-MANIFEST-URL table
issue_evidence_correction.measured: absent at PR head 5c39f9ea6655f3eff25ef8c35b3f5e58486cc4f7 of PR #1401, while 676 sibling manifests are present at that same head
issue_evidence_correction.consequence: UTV2-1652 correctly remains dispatch-blocking. It was not force-suppressed. This is fixture 4's anti-regression control firing on live data.
issue_evidence_correction.fixture_3_note: Fixture 3 is retained under the UTV2-1652 identifiers as a synthetic valid on-branch manifest, because requirement 1 still needs a second independent positive case.

safety_posture.guard_weakened_note: No genuinely blocking condition was weakened. Suppression is admitted only where a manifest was positively resolved at the exact PR head, and an unresolvable head falls back to the old behaviour with an infra error recorded. Transient, auth, and unclassifiable Linear failures all remain blocking.

known_gaps: Head manifests are resolved for open PRs only; a merged PR's manifest is expected on main.
If a PR head commit cannot be fetched locally, resolution is abandoned, an infra error is recorded, and the check falls back to the working-tree copy. Fail-closed.
The 624 ORCH-HISTORICAL-DECAY warnings are real deleted-entity debt spanning UTV2-570..1566. This lane classifies them; it does not remediate them. UTV2-1512 remediation is UTV2-1757.

docs/06_status/lanes/UTV2-1758.json is not in file_scope_lock: ops:lane-start requires every scope path to exist before it runs but is what creates the manifest, and file_scope_lock is immutable afterwards. Recorded as a known S1 scope-diff risk rather than worked around.
